XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine warning light coming on and sporadic power drop with sudden engine shutdowns

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: Engine fails to start, with immobiliser warning light (red) flashing on the instrument panel.

  • Faults detected by self-diagnosis:
  • U3003 (Incorrect battery voltage - wiring/battery/alternator)
  • U0100 (CAN data bus, engine control unit 1 - Loss of communication)
  • B11D8 (Impact signal, open circuit/short circuit – Wiring/impact sensors)
  • U0423 (Central electronic control unit (Body computer) – Invalid data received)
  • U2005 (Vehicle speed)
  • B1089 (Auxiliary switch missing)
  • U0103 (CAN data bus, gear selector control unit - Loss of communication)
  • P1607 (Fault indicator/MIL control circuit – Wiring/indicator/instrument panel)
  • Cause: Faulty injection control unit

• Action: Check the correct operation and condition of the injection control unit; if necessary, repair or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment on the driver’s side, near the starter motor. In this case, a lack of communication with the injection control unit was noted; a visual inspection of the component revealed no abnormalities.
